<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 14"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Cleansing Transformation](/Feats.aspx?ID=5406) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Druid" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=583" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 57

**Prerequisites**
[Healing Transformation](/Feats.aspx?ID=4742)

</column>

---

You learn to cleanse bodily toxins alongside the transformations of your shape-changing magic. When you use Healing Transformation, your [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670) spell can also attempt to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) one [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=578) or [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=669) afflicting the target. If you don't successfully counteract it, you can't use Cleansing Transformation against that specific affliction for 24 hours.
name: Cleansing Transformation
